subject.title: refactor(net): extract local one-hop fetch dispatcher

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this internal manual-redirect dispatcher as the approved future extension seam inside the SSRF-guarded fetch loop?
rationale: The patch is intentionally behavior-preserving, but whether a new abstraction belongs in this security-sensitive core path is a product and architecture choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the narrow internal seam
options.body: Rebase and merge the extraction while keeping it private and retaining all policy, redirect, and release authority in guarded fetch.

options.title: Keep the current inline transport call
options.body: Close the refactor direction if maintainers do not want to create a future extension seam before a second transport owner exists.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow internal seam
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge the extraction while keeping it private and retaining all policy, redirect, and release authority in guarded fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected maintainer label and cross-cutting network-boundary decision call for repository-level architecture direction.
